_note: E3 — placement quality judged BY EYE from tools/scan-eval/out/overlay/*.png, which are drawn by exp-place.py and are git-ignored because they are derived from third-party plan images. This file is the calibration evidence for ScanMapper.MAX_TRUSTED_ROOMS, kept in the repo so the threshold is reproducible rather than resting on one machine's scratch directory. Re-create the overlays with: python tools/scan-eval/exp-place.py
_finding: Room count separates good from bad placement (good 10-11, bad 15-24, no overlap). Coverage does NOT: two plans with identical coverage 0.421 placed well and badly, and the corpus's highest coverage 0.760 placed worse than its lowest-but-one.
_caveat: 6 plans judged, 2 of them good. 13 and 14 rooms were never observed.
